messages:
emma.pm: quick kickoff for CloudLane marketplace + joint webinar. target launch in two weeks. need owners for landing, routing, demo, and blog.
raj.gtm: i'll build the landing + registration. prefer Tue or Thu mornings PT. will AB test CTAs: "Start trial" vs "Request private demo" split by cookie.
tori.prod: i'll own the demo + benchmark narrative. asked eng for conservative latency and cost deltas — must be approved before publishing.
cloudlane_rep: CloudLane can provide co-branded hero, 1-sentence quote, and a 20s clip by next Wed. legal okayed assets.
zane.opsbot: automation: created Marketo list MKTO_CloudLane_May2026 and SFDC queue CloudLane_Webinar_May. Sync job 9422 scheduled hourly.
raj.gtm: form fields: name, company, role, company size (optional). map role->tag: eng/platform => technical_lead. route high-intent leads to SDR Pool C.
tori.prod: demo plan: 8m product walkthrough, 10m customer story, 15m Q&A. will demo Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private switch under 90s. prep 1-page SDR brief with conservative % deltas.
emma.pm: blog plan: publish benchmark-led post + webinar recording. owner: emma. raj to provide social clips after recording.
zane.opsbot: sales ops routing snippet: if utm_source=="cloudlane_market" OR source=="cloudlane_listing" => add to MKTO_CloudLane_May2026 and assign CloudLane_Webinar_May.
raj.gtm: timeline: landing live by Friday, partner assets by Wed EOD, rehearsal Mon 10am PT.
emma.pm: thanks all. i'll post hero copy variants in 2 hours and run readiness check Friday. :rocket:
